newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 54,700 MT were mainly the result of increases for Saudi Arabia (26,000 MT, switched from unknown), Panama (9,500 MT), Venezuela (9,400 MT), and Colombia (8,600 MT) being partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (26, 000 MT).
Sales for the 1997/98 marketing year of 58,900 MT were mainly for unknown destinations (37,000 MT) and Tunisia (13,000 MT).

Exports of 109,300 MT were three and one-fifth times the previous week and two and one-quarter times the 4-week average. The Philippines (52,800 MT), Saudi Arabia (26,000 MT), and Venezuela (11,200 MT) were the major recipients.
